description: PhysioKeys helps clinicians, students, educators, and researchers search physiotherapy and rehabilitation evidence from ChatGPT. Users can search curated PhysioKeys records or PubMed, fetch article details, review abstracts and rights-verified cached full text when available, generate citations, view saved-article metadata, save PMIDs to their private library, and check account allowances. The plugin is intended only for de-identified research and citation workflows and may refuse requests containing patient-identifiable information. It does not provide emergency diagnosis or personalized medical advice.

defaultPrompt: Find systematic reviews on exercise therapy for knee osteoarthritis.
